sec.title: August 31 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 494)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **August 31** across exotic comic strip jungle adventures, West Coast hardboiled detective investigations, newspaper flashbulb murder mysteries, and Bicentennial documentary surveys, Matt Crowley as Alex Raymond's *Jungle Jim* (1940, 1946), Bob Bailey and Virginia Gregg in *Let George Do It* for Chevron (1953), Staats Cotsworth in *Casey, Crime Photographer* (1950), Gordon MacRae on *Texaco Star Theater* (1947), and BBC Radio 4's documentary on Maryland (1940–1975):
